_readme: Field Notes settings. Articles live one per file in content/field-notes/<slug>.md (JSON front matter, Markdown body) and are edited through /admin (Decap CMS, Git-backed). published:false keeps an article out of the index, sitemap, related links and teasers; production builds do not generate its page (404). Review builds render it at its URL with a Draft banner for proofreading. Body Markdown supports ## and ### headings, paragraphs, lists, > notes, links, uploaded images and ::media[id] for approved Photografik library media. legacyUrls = old Squarespace paths this article replaces one-to-one (vercel.json must redirect each of them here); see content/legacy-articles.json.
_editorial: James, Sep 25 2026: byline is Photografik Studios. Reuse original blog substance and URL mappings.
